The '''Mana-D5 Submersible''' was a model of [[Submarine/Legends|submarine]] that was used on the planet [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Alliance Commander|Outlander]] used such vehicle to [[Operation on Manaan|escape]] the [[Genetics Laboratory G-1]] during the [[Revanite crisis]].<ref name="TOR:DoM" /> Mana-D5 Submersibles were sold by [[Bakmar]] and [[Orloth]] on the [[Mercantile Plaza]] on Manaan.<ref name="TOR:MDS" /> Mana-D5 Submersibles were used by the [[Syphus Collective]] during the [[Invasion of Manaan]].<ref name="TOR:SSJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Mana-D5.png|thumb|right|220px|The player speeder version of the submersible.]]
The Mana-D5 Submersible first appeared in the flashpoint "Depths of Manaan" of the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR:DoM" /> Although it was a submersible, it could also be bought by players from Bakmar and Orloth on the Mercantile Plaza for twenty Manaan research data and used as a regular landspeeder mount.<ref name="TOR:MDS" />
